title: The Sentence Every Con Artist Uses
hook: Every con artist uses this sentence.

scenes.caption: There is one sentence behind almost every con, every scam, every fraud you've ever heard of. It has four words.
scenes.caption_roman: There is one sentence behind almost every con, every scam, every fraud you've ever heard of. It has four words.

scenes.caption: "You have to decide now." That's it. Pressure plus a deadline. The moment you feel rushed, your brain stops thinking.
scenes.caption_roman: "You have to decide now." That's it. Pressure plus a deadline. The moment you feel rushed, your brain stops thinking.

scenes.caption: Scammers can't let you pause, because a calm mind asks questions. A rushed mind just obeys.
scenes.caption_roman: Scammers can't let you pause, because a calm mind asks questions. A rushed mind just obeys.

scenes.caption: So they stack urgency. The offer expires. The warrant is issued. The account closes in ten minutes.
scenes.caption_roman: So they stack urgency. The offer expires. The warrant is issued. The account closes in ten minutes.

scenes.caption: Notice: legitimate institutions — your bank, the government, real companies — never demand secrecy or instant payment.
scenes.caption_roman: Notice: legitimate institutions — your bank, the government, real companies — never demand secrecy or instant payment.

scenes.caption: Here's your defense. The second anyone pressures you to act now, you stop. You hang up. You wait a full day.
scenes.caption_roman: Here's your defense. The second anyone pressures you to act now, you stop. You hang up. You wait a full day.

scenes.caption: Tell a friend before you send a dollar. Real opportunities survive one night of sleep. Scams don't. Follow Coercion Files for the psychology they don't teach you in school.
scenes.caption_roman: Tell a friend before you send a dollar. Real opportunities survive one night of sleep. Scams don't. Follow Coercion Files for the psychology they don't teach you in school.
